pairs.target: dìèrtiān xiàwǔ , tǎ wéi zài huò háng hòumén děng nài lěi , shǒulǐ jiā zhe wéi lǎoshī zhǔn tā dàilái shuōmíng de nà zhāng lù tú .
pairs.english: The next afternoon, Tavi waited for Nerai at the freight firm's back door, holding the route map Teacher Vey had allowed him to bring to explain.
pairs.hanzi: 第二天下午，塔维在货行后门等奈蕾，手里夹着维老师准他带来说明的那张路图。

pairs.target: tú shì sòng qù de zǒulù yífèn de fùběn , méiyǒu jièsù rénjiā de xìngmíng , tā zhào wéi lǎoshī dehuà , jiāng zhǐtǒng yìzhí liúzài xī shàng .
pairs.english: The map was a copy of the walking-route version sent over, without the lodging households' names; following Teacher Vey's instructions, he kept the paper tube on his knees throughout.
pairs.hanzi: 图是送去的走路一份的副本，没有借宿人家的姓名，他照维老师的话，将纸筒一直留在膝上。

pairs.target: nài lěi cóng lǐmiàn chūlái , jiào tā gēnzhe jìn yuàn , xiān shuō jīnrì zhǐ jiěshì zìjǐ huà guò de dìfāng , jiàqián hé rénshǒu bù guī tā dá .
pairs.english: Nerai came out from inside and told him to follow into the courtyard, first saying that today he should only explain places he himself had drawn; prices and staffing were not his to answer.
pairs.hanzi: 奈蕾从里面出来，叫他跟着进院，先说今日只解释自己画过的地方，价钱和人手不归他答。

pairs.target: yuànlǐ tíng le liǎngliàngchē , chēyuán gē zài mùjià shàng , yǒurén zhèng xiè yìzhī lún , qiāojīshēng gé yízhèn biàn bǎ huà jiéduàn .
pairs.english: Two wagons stood in the courtyard, their shafts resting on wooden trestles; someone was removing a wheel, and the knocking cut off conversation every so often.
pairs.hanzi: 院里停了两辆车，车辕搁在木架上，有人正卸一只轮，敲击声隔一阵便把话截断。

pairs.target: kàoqiáng de zhuōzi hěnzhǎi , huò háng de rén nuózǒu bànwǎn lěng fàn , ràng tā jiāng tú tānkāi .
pairs.english: The table by the wall was very narrow; the firm's man moved aside half a bowl of cold rice and let him spread the map out.
pairs.hanzi: 靠墙的桌子很窄，货行的人挪走半碗冷饭，让他将图摊开。

pairs.target: nà rén wèn cóng nánpō wǎng hé chà , yǔ hòu rào chūqù de nàduàn shìbushì hái zài , tǎ wéi xiān zhǎodào zìjǐ huà de zhuǎnwān , cái shuō shàng huí shì zhèyàng zǒu de .
pairs.english: The man asked whether that detour after the rain was still there on the way from South Slope to River Fork; Tavi first found the turn he himself had drawn, then said that was how they had gone last time.
pairs.hanzi: 那人问从南坡往河岔，雨后绕出去的那段是不是还在，塔维先找到自己画的转弯，才说上回是这样走的。

pairs.target: nài lěi zài pángbiān bǔ shàng zuìhòu zǒuguò de rìzi , méiyǒu tì tú shàng zài tiān yíjù rújīn yě néng zǒu .
pairs.english: Beside him Nerai added the date of their last passage; she did not add another line on the map saying it was passable now too.
pairs.hanzi: 奈蕾在旁边补上最后走过的日子，没有替图上再添一句如今也能走。

pairs.target: yígè tuīchē de lǎohàn zhàn dào zhuōbiān , shǒuzhǐ zài zhé kǒu páng tíng zhe , wèn zhè tiáo xìxiàn néng bunéng tōngchē .
pairs.english: An old man who pushed carts came to stand beside the table, a finger resting by the fold, and asked whether that thin line could take a cart.
pairs.hanzi: 一个推车的老汉站到桌边，手指在折口旁停着，问这条细线能不能通车。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi shuō nà shì rén zǒu de tà shí , shítou zhījiān yǒukōng , huà zài zhǐ shàng kànzhe lián qǐlái , lúnzi guòbúqù .
pairs.english: Tavi said those were stepping stones for people on foot, with gaps between the stones; drawn on paper they looked joined up, but wheels could not cross.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维说那是人走的踏石，石头之间有空，画在纸上看着连起来，轮子过不去。

pairs.target: lǎohàn méi bǎshǒu shōuhuí , shuō ruò xià yífèn réng zhèyàng huà , zuò wūlǐ kàn tú de rén huì ràng tā bǎ chē tuī dào shuǐ lǐ .
pairs.english: The old man did not withdraw his hand; he said if the next version was still drawn this way, people reading the map indoors would make him push his cart into the water.
pairs.hanzi: 老汉没把手收回，说若下一份仍这样画，坐屋里看图的人会让他把车推到水里。

pairs.target: tā dùzi hūrán xiǎng le , tǎ wéi wǎng nà wǎnfàn kàn , tā shuō shì zìjǐ de , gāngcái chèn xiè lún pǎo lái chī liǎngkǒu , yí zuòxià biàn yòu bèi rén jiào zǒu .
pairs.english: His stomach suddenly rumbled; Tavi looked toward that bowl of rice, and he said it was his, that he had just run over to eat a couple of mouthfuls during the wheel removal, only to be called away again as soon as he sat down.
pairs.hanzi: 他肚子忽然响了，塔维往那碗饭看，他说是自己的，刚才趁卸轮跑来吃两口，一坐下便又被人叫走。

alignment.english: as soon as he sat down

pairs.target: huò háng de rén shuō zǎo jiào tā chī wán zài zuò , tā shuō ruò chēlún yě kěn zhào zhè jù huà děng , zìjǐ lián fànhòu de jiào dōu shuì dé chéng .
pairs.english: The firm's man said he had long since told him to finish eating before working; he said if the wheels too would wait as instructed, he could manage even a nap after his meal.
pairs.hanzi: 货行的人说早叫他吃完再做，他说若车轮也肯照这句话等，自己连饭后的觉都睡得成。

pairs.target: huò háng de rén shuō tú shàng zhùmíng le bùxíng , lǎohàn wèn zhuāngchē de rén kàn de shì nǎ yìháng zì , zuóyè sòngdào tā shǒushàng de zhǐshì yìzhāng chāo dān .
pairs.english: The firm's man said the map specified walking; the old man asked which line of text the loaders looked at, since what reached his hands last night was only a copied slip.
pairs.hanzi: 货行的人说图上注明了步行，老汉问装车的人看的是哪一行字，昨夜送到他手上的只是一张抄单。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi xiǎngqǐ lín kē shuō chē búhuì gēnzhe tuì , dītóu kàn nàtiáo xìxiàn , dìyīcì juéde zì xiě zài pángbiān wèibì jiù gòu .
pairs.english: Tavi remembered Lin Ke saying a wagon would not retreat along with them; he lowered his head to look at that thin line and for the first time felt that text written beside it might not be enough.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维想起林珂说车不会跟着退，低头看那条细线，第一次觉得字写在旁边未必就够。

pairs.target: tā qǔchū zìjǐ de liànxí zhǐ , jiāng tà shíhuà chéng duànkāi de jǐ xiǎo duàn , xiàmiàn liúchū tōng bùliǎo chē de wèizhì , dìgěi lǎohàn kàn .
pairs.english: He took out his own practice sheet, drew the stepping stones as a few broken short segments, left space below for the cart restriction, and handed it to the old man to look at.
pairs.hanzi: 他取出自己的练习纸，将踏石画成断开的几小段，下面留出通不了车的位置，递给老汉看。

pairs.target: lǎohàn ná zhǐjiǎ huà le liǎngxià , shuō ruò kànbùqīng , zhǐ huì dāng zhèlǐ lòu huà le , jiào tā bǎ lúnzi guòbúqù jǐgè zì nuó dào xiàn páng .
pairs.english: The old man scratched twice with a fingernail, saying that if it was unclear people would only take this as an omission; he told him to move the words wheels cannot cross beside the line.
pairs.hanzi: 老汉拿指甲划了两下，说若看不清，只会当这里漏画了，叫他把轮子过不去几个字挪到线旁。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi zhào zuò , huò háng de rén què bǎ bǐ ànzhù , wèn nà hé chà wǎng chì píng de yíduàn , néng bunéng yě shùnshǒu bǔ shàng .
pairs.english: Tavi did as asked, but the firm's man pressed down on the pen and asked whether that stretch from River Fork to Red Flats could also be filled in while they were at it.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维照做，货行的人却把笔按住，问那河岔往赤坪的一段，能不能也顺手补上。

pairs.target: nài lěi xiān jiāng zhǐjuǎn de lìngyìtóu yāpíng , shuō zǒulù de zhè yífèn zhǐ dào hé chà , wǎng wài lìng zhǎo kànguò de rén , nàduàn tāmen méi zǒu , wèn tā yě wèn bù chūlái .
pairs.english: Nerai first flattened the other end of the paper roll, saying this walking version only went as far as River Fork; beyond that they should find someone else who had seen it, since they had not walked that stretch and asking him would not produce an answer either.
pairs.hanzi: 奈蕾先将纸卷的另一头压平，说走路的这一份只到河岔，往外另找看过的人，那段他们没走，问他也问不出来。

pairs.target: tā yòng de shì yòushǒu , zuǒshǒu fàngzài zhuōbiān , mò liǎnggēn zhǐtou huǎnhuǎn shōulǒng , méiyǒu gēnzhe tā shuōhuà de kuàimàn yìqǐ dòng .
pairs.english: She was using her right hand; her left rested at the table's edge, its last two fingers slowly curling in, not moving together with the pace of her speech.
pairs.hanzi: 她用的是右手，左手放在桌边，末两根指头缓缓收拢，没有跟着她说话的快慢一起动。

pairs.target: nà rén shuō zìjǐ zhǐshì wènwèn , yòu shuō ruò yào duō tiān yìmíng hùlù de , qián bùnéng cóng tiānshàng lái .
pairs.english: The man said he was only asking, then said if they wanted to add one more road guard, the money could not come from the sky.
pairs.hanzi: 那人说自己只是问问，又说若要多添一名护路的，钱不能从天上来。

pairs.target: lǎohàn lìkè wèn , nà shìbushì gāi ràng shǎozhuāng de nà jǐbāo huò yě cóng zhàng shàng kàndejiàn , bié yímiàn shěng rén , yímiàn shuō chē háiyǒu kōng .
pairs.english: The old man immediately asked whether that meant they should also make visible in the accounts those few bales left unloaded, rather than on the one hand save on staff and on the other say the wagon still had room.
pairs.hanzi: 老汉立刻问，那是不是该让少装的那几包货也从账上看得见，别一面省人，一面说车还有空。

pairs.target: yuànlǐ qiāo lún de rén tíng le shǒu , zhuōbiān yìshí zhǐ shèng zhǐbiān bèi fēng chuīxiǎng .
pairs.english: The person knocking at the wheel in the courtyard paused; for a moment beside the table there was only the sound of the paper's edge rustling in the wind.
pairs.hanzi: 院里敲轮的人停了手，桌边一时只剩纸边被风吹响。

alignment.english: The person knocking at the wheel

pairs.target: nài lěi shuō jīnrì zhè zhāng tú bú tì shuí juédìng zhuāng duōshǎo , yě bú tì shuí xiě yílù tàipíng , ruò bú zhào zhè liǎngjù suàn , tā nìngkěn shōuhuí qù gǎirì zài tán .
pairs.english: Nerai said today's map would not decide anyone's cargo amount, nor write a promise of peace all along the road for anyone; if they did not reckon according to those two points, she would rather take it back and talk another day.
pairs.hanzi: 奈蕾说今日这张图不替谁决定装多少，也不替谁写一路太平，若不照这两句算，她宁肯收回去改日再谈。

alignment.english: a promise of peace all along the road

pairs.target: huò háng de rén kàn tā yízhèn , zhōngyú chōuchū yìzhāng kōng zhǐ , bǎ zǒulù fùběn lìng liè yìháng , hùlù de rénshǒu réng kòng zhe , méiyǒu dāngchǎng diǎntóu .
pairs.english: The firm's man looked at her a while, finally drew out a blank sheet, and listed the walking copy on a separate line; the road-guard staffing stayed blank, with no assent on the spot.
pairs.hanzi: 货行的人看她一阵，终于抽出一张空纸，把走路副本另列一行，护路的人手仍空着，没有当场点头。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi yǐwéi yào bèi wèn diū tú de shì , děng le bànshǎng , què méi rén wèn , tā yòu yǒudiǎn pà zhèng yīnwèi méi rén wèn , cái huì bèi dàngchéng méi fāshēng .
pairs.english: Tavi thought he would be asked about the lost map and waited a long while, but nobody asked; he was also a little afraid that precisely because nobody asked, it would be treated as never having happened.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维以为要被问丢图的事，等了半晌，却没人问，他又有点怕正因为没人问，才会被当成没发生。

pairs.target: tā zhǐzhe hé chà wài nà kuài kòng chù , shuō nàlǐ búshì méiyǒu dōngxī , shì zhè yífèn méi huà , yě méiyǒu píng zhè zhāng tú tìrén kànguò .
pairs.english: He pointed to that blank patch beyond River Fork, saying it was not that nothing existed there; rather, this copy left it undrawn, nor had anyone surveyed it for others on the strength of this map.
pairs.hanzi: 他指着河岔外那块空处，说那里不是没有东西，是这一份没画，也没有凭这张图替人看过。

pairs.target: lǎohàn zhè cái jiāng shǒu shōuhuí lái , bǎ zhuōbiān de lěng fàn duān zǒu , shuō nà jiù bié ràng chāo dān de rén bǎ zhèkuài kòngbái cái diào .
pairs.english: Only then did the old man draw back his hand and take away the cold rice beside the table, saying in that case do not let the person copying the slips trim off this blank patch.
pairs.hanzi: 老汉这才将手收回来，把桌边的冷饭端走，说那就别让抄单的人把这块空白裁掉。

pairs.target: línzǒu , nài lěi bǎ lù tú liúgěi huò háng hé kàn , jiāng tā de liànxí zhǐ dìhuí , jiào tā xiān dàigěi wéi lǎoshī , bùxǔ zìjǐ qù gǎi rénjiā yǐjīng shōu zhe de nà fèn .
pairs.english: Before leaving, Nerai left the route map for the firm to examine and handed his practice sheet back, telling him to take it to Teacher Vey first; he was not allowed to change the copy they already held on his own.
pairs.hanzi: 临走，奈蕾把路图留给货行核看，将他的练习纸递回，叫他先带给维老师，不许自己去改人家已经收着的那份。

pairs.target: chū hòumén shí , tǎ wéi wèn shìbushì tán huài le , tā shuō hái méi tánwán , tíngxià shuǎi le shuǎi yòushǒu , cái qù fú bèi fēng xiānqǐ de lǐngkǒu .
pairs.english: As they went out the back door, Tavi asked whether the talks had gone wrong; she said they were not finished yet, stopped to shake out her right hand, and only then steadied her collar lifted by the wind.
pairs.hanzi: 出后门时，塔维问是不是谈坏了，她说还没谈完，停下甩了甩右手，才去扶被风掀起的领口。

alignment.english: As they went out the back door

pairs.target: tā méiyǒu zhuīwèn jǐshí néng chéng , bǎ nà zhāng huà zhe duàn shí de zhǐ yājìn cèzi , mén lǐ de rén yòu qiāoqǐ lúnzi , zhè yícì tā zhīdào tāmen zài qiāo shénme le .
pairs.english: He did not pursue when it might be settled, tucked the sheet showing broken stone segments into his notebook, and the people inside began knocking at the wheel again; this time he knew what they were knocking at.
pairs.hanzi: 他没有追问几时能成，把那张画着断石的纸压进册子，门里的人又敲起轮子，这一次他知道他们在敲什么了。
